races.verdict: A big field but it's hard to get away from top-weight CHOSEN SHANT , who won this corresponding race last year and has been in top form over fences here in recent weeks. She can enhance a fine track record at the expense of Avandra , who is a long-standing maiden but is going through a good spell. Annarubyrose and Tropical Twist are another couple who may feature. CHOSEN SHANT (IRE) AVANDRA (IRE) ANNARUBYROSE (IRE)
